notes: Corrected אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה → *the slopes of Pisgah*: the accepted alignment supplied the *the* on the construct and left the article on הַפִּסְגָּה unrepresented. The rectum is rendered anarthrously and only one *the* is written, so rule 29 gives it to the present article and leaves the construct bare, as `כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל` → *the furnace of iron* does.
יָם הָעֲרָבָה → *the sea of the Arabah* is unchanged: two *the*s are written, so the article takes the one before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
